title: BuildWithoutTestsRequest
description: What a builder reads to build a slice whose tests another wrote: the slice's conditions, the interface files' paths, the test files' paths it may not change, its worktree, the practices and what it declared; from round 2 on, the reviewer's findings for it and what it may be told of the failing cases. It holds no line of the tests.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the slice's worktree.

fixed.description: The test files the slice's fails-first items name. The builder may not change them, and has none of their text.

folder.description: The slice's worktree, relative to the project, as worktrees.cut made it, such as .forge/worktrees/TR2.

practices.description: The practices files to read before writing, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

findings.description: From round 2 on: the reviewer's findings for the builder.

rules.description: The rules of the committed design that the slice's actions apply: write each as a pure function named in camelCase after the rule, taking and giving those values, and the thin function around it that reads and writes what its action names. Empty when there is none.

finding.description: One finding of the reviewer, for the test writer or for the builder.

to.description: Who the finding is for: the test writer corrects the tests, the builder the code.

case.description: A case's name, as the tests name it.

question.description: The question the case fails: Q1 to Q10 of reviewing-tests.md, negative-paths, condition, or the id of a practice given.

fix.description: One sentence on what would fix it. For the builder it shares no run of 20 characters with the tests.

failing.description: What of a failed test run the builder may be told: the failed must items, each failing case's name, its file when the slice names it, and its message less every run it shares with a test; the count of messages withheld in part or whole; the test files that did not load, by path only.

items.description: A failing case as the builder may be told it.

name.description: The case's name, cut at 200 characters, with no control character.

file.description: The test file, only when it is one the slice names; its path is already in the builder's task.

message.description: The first line of the runner's message, control characters as spaces, cut at 200 characters, each stretch that shares a run of 20 characters with a test of the slice shown as one …; left out when no letter or digit is left of it, and a fixed sentence saying so when the line held none to begin with.

withheld.description: How many messages were withheld in part or whole because they share a run of 20 characters with a test.

notListed.description: How many more failing cases the runner counted.

notLoaded.description: The slice's test files that did not load, by path only.
